author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: The "Keep floodlight on indefinitely" setting is renamed "After On, keep the floodlight on until Off", with a note on what it does: it acts only after Hubitat turns the light on, sends On again every 2 minutes until Off, and has no effect on cameras with Reolink's own keep-on. The setting itself and its value are unchanged. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
